newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's Trans Zambezi extends share offer date.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Trans Zambezi extends share offer date.

text.p: Southern African conglomerate Trans Zambezi Industries Ltd (TZI), which plans to list on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange next month, said on Thursday it had extended its share offer subscription date to February 4.
Previously subscribers had until January 30 to apply for the two million shares on offer.
Arranger ING Barings said the extension was made to coincide with TZI's listing in mid-February.
"There's also a little bit of delay in the paper work," ING Barings official Martin McWilliam told Reuters.
The TZI listing would be in the form of Zimbabwe depositary receipts, each of which would be equivalent to one ordinary share in TZI. The two million shares are being offered at U.S.$3.25 each.
TZI, which has 46.3 million shares listed in Luxembourg, told Reuters earlier this month it was keen to localise around 20 percent of its shares on the Zimbabwe bourse over the next year.
It would also be seeking listings in Lusaka and London.
